test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II (Statistics) Official Paper-II (Held On: 19 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT true about collecting data through structured interviews?

options.text: They involve the use of highly standardised techniques of recording
The interviewer follows a rigid laid down procedure.
They involve the use of a set of predetermined questions.
The sequence of asked questions can be changed.

solution:
**Concept Used:**

Structured interviews use fixed questions, order, and standardised recording for all respondents.

**Explanation:**

 
• Structured interviews are highly standardised
 
• Recording methods are fixed
 
• Procedure followed is rigid
 
• Questions are predetermined
 
• Question order remains the same
 
• Changing sequence reduces uniformity

 Hence, changing question order is not allowed

**The Correct Answer is:The sequence of asked questions can be changed**
